newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India, U.S. holidays sap will to trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India, U.S. holidays sap will to trade.

text.p: Holidays on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) today and tomorrow and Veterans Day in the U.S. limited trading of Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) in London on Monday.
"Nothing much happened with Bombay closed, but with the National Stock Exchange ending higher again, we expect the locals to firm when the BSE opens on Wednesday," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed up 0.24 points at 61/75 points, with the premium over the local market at 15.67 percent, the same as Friday.
The NSE 50 share index rose 14.67 points to 894.67.
"People will start positioning themselves tomorrow for when the BSE opens on Wednesday. Tomorrow will be more active," said the trader.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 0.77 points, 1.20 percent, at 64.91, a premium of 25.95 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index fell 1.29 points to 729.53.

The Capel Taiwan GDR Index shed 0.26 points to 90.16, a premium of 0.99 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 11.96 points or 0.18 percent to 6,571.12. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
